title: Parking License Addendum — Guest Passes
content:
A guest pass under the Parking License is issued only to a license holder whose license is active.

## Terms

(a) **Eligibility.** The status on the license record decides; a pass is issued only while the license is active.

(b) **Monthly allowance.** Passes are limited to the product's passes per month, per license, per calendar month. The month that counts is the calendar month containing the first night of the requested pass, and the passes counted are those issued on the license whose first night falls in that month.

(c) **Length of a pass.** Each pass covers at most the product's consecutive-night limit.

(d) **No carry-over.** Unused passes do not carry over to the next month.

(e) **Longer stays.** A guest vehicle staying longer must be registered on a license of its own, and a guest who stays long enough to become an unauthorized occupant under the Apartment Home Lease cannot be covered by passes.

## Illustration (a hypothetical allowance of 4 passes a month and 3 nights a pass)

| Request | Passes already issued with a first night in that month | Result |
|---|---|---|
| First night 30 March, 2 nights | 4 in March | not issued: the March allowance is used |
| First night 1 April, 2 nights | 4 in March, 0 in April | issued: it counts in April |
| First night 31 March, running into April | 3 in March | issued: it counts in March, the month of its first night |
| First night 5 April, 4 nights | 0 in April | one pass cannot cover 4 nights |

A March allowance left unused does not add passes to April.
